verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs describe granular data-retention controls (retention only affects code-related data like learnings/context, model-output logging is separately toggleable) and state self-hosted Enterprise customers can opt out of all data retention at any time, alongside a no-training guarantee. However, evidence does not show a self-serve deletion mechanism or full retention/opt-out control for standard (non-self-hosted) cloud customers, and no independent corroboration exists. Missing for 10: explicit deletion workflow/API for cloud-tier users, retention period specifics, and third-party verification of retention claims.
